seeds.prompt:

Reservoir Godavari: start 160 MCM, end 20 MCM, total capacity 210 MCM
Reservoir Yamuna: start 430 MCM, end 350 MCM, total capacity 500 MCM
Reservoir Narmada: start 95 MCM, end 12 MCM, total capacity 130 MCM

seeds.expected: (a) Percentage of start-of-season water lost — Kaveri: (285 − 72) ÷ 285 × 100 = 213 ÷ 285 × 100 ≈ 74.7%. Godavari: (160 − 20) ÷ 160 × 100 = 140 ÷ 160 × 100 = 87.5%. Yamuna: (430 − 350) ÷ 430 × 100 = 80 ÷ 430 × 100 ≈ 18.6%. Narmada: (95 − 12) ÷ 95 × 100 = 83 ÷ 95 × 100 ≈ 87.4%. Godavari lost the highest percentage at 87.5%. (b) End-of-season storage as a percentage of total capacity — Kaveri: 72 ÷ 340 × 100 ≈ 21.2%. Godavari: 20 ÷ 210 × 100 ≈ 9.5%. Yamuna: 350 ÷ 500 × 100 = 70.0%. Narmada: 12 ÷ 130 × 100 ≈ 9.2%. Narmada is at the lowest percentage of its total capacity at 9.2%.
